blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No bettor won the ₱305.12 million Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot or the ₱15 million MegaLotto 6/45 jackpot in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Monday, Oct. 26, 2026. According to the PCSO results provided, the Grand Lotto 6/55 draw produced the winning combination 27-38-44-51-20-47, with a jackpot prize of ₱305.12 million. No ticket matched all six numbers. The MegaLotto 6/45 draw yielded the winning combination 06-34-45-36-30-16 for a ₱15 million jackpot. No bettor won the top prize.
